report.markdown:
# Incident report: Orders are failing intermittently in production

- **Investigation:** inv-demo-s2 (INC-1102)
- **Service:** order-service · **Environment:** production
- **Severity:** high · **Confidence:** 88%
- **Affected services:** order-service

## Summary

order-service is restarting every ~4 minutes because it runs out of memory. Release v2.3.1 made the in-process order cache unbounded, so memory grows until the container is OOMKilled; requests fail with 503 during each restart.

## Root cause

Memory leak in order-service v2.3.1 (unbounded in-process order cache) causes OutOfMemoryError and repeated OOMKilled restarts; requests fail with 503 during restarts. _(confidence 88%)_

### Supporting evidence

- `ev-s2-metrics-1` (metric, prometheus): Memory climbs 110 → 256 Mi and resets every ~4 minutes (sawtooth = leak + OOMKilled) [link](http://localhost:3000/d/service-overview/service-overview?var-service=order-service&from=1790344200000&to=1790346000000&viewPanel=Memory)
- `ev-s2-k8s-1` (k8s_event, kubernetes): Pod order-service-65c484cb48-j62fc: last state OOMKilled (exit 137), restart_count 5 [link](http://localhost:3000/d/k8s-workloads/k8s-workloads?var-deployment=order-service&from=1790344200000&to=1790346000000)
- `ev-s2-logs-1` (log, elasticsearch): 9 'java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space' errors since 14:05Z [link](http://localhost:5601/app/discover#/?_g=(time:(from:'2026-09-25T13:50:00Z',to:'2026-09-25T14:20:00Z'))&_a=(index:'order-prod-*',query:(language:kuery,query:'FROM%20order-prod-*%20%7C%20STATS%20count%20BY%20pattern')))
- `ev-s2-code-1` (commit, git): Commit 5e1c0a2 'cache order lookups in memory' makes the cache unbounded
- `ev-s2-alerts-1` (alert, alertmanager): PodOOMKilled (critical) firing since 14:06Z [link](http://localhost:9093/#/alerts?filter=%7Balertname%3D%22PodOOMKilled%22%7D)
- `ev-s2-knowledge-1` (doc, knowledge-base): Runbook 'Memory leak and OOMKilled': roll back, then bound caches [link](https://github.com/vigneshAJ1503/AI_Incident_Agents/blob/main/knowledge-base/runbooks/memory-leak-oom.md#mitigation)

## Impact

Intermittent 503 on order creation (≈8% of requests during restarts) since 14:02Z.

## Timeline (UTC)

- 13:50:00 order-service v2.3.1 rolled out (unbounded order cache) _(code)_
- 14:02:00 Memory starts climbing in a sawtooth _(metrics)_
- 14:03:10 First 'GC overhead limit exceeded' warning _(logs)_
- 14:05:40 First OutOfMemoryError _(logs)_
- 14:06:09 Container OOMKilled (exit 137) _(k8s)_
- 14:10:00 PodCrashLooping fires _(alerts)_

## Next steps

1. Roll back order-service to v2.3.0.
2. Bound the order cache (ORDER_CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES=10000).
3. Close OPS-21 with this RCA.
